Print a shell completion script (run `iso completions --help` for setup)

Usage: iso completions <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>  Shell to generate completions for [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Examples:
  # bash — system-wide
  iso completions bash | sudo tee /etc/bash_completion.d/iso > /dev/null

  # bash — user
  iso completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/iso

  # zsh — user (ensure dir is on $fpath; restart shell)
  iso completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_iso

  # fish — user
  iso completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/iso.fish

Dynamic completion (live instance / image / profile names) requires one
extra line in your shell rc:

  bash:  source <(COMPLETE=bash iso)
  zsh:   source <(COMPLETE=zsh iso)
  fish:  source (COMPLETE=fish iso | psub)
